Abstract: The effect of germline mutations on survival outcomes of breast cancer - Study from a tertiary care center in North India.. data.text: PMID 42955426: "Germline BRCA-Lynch syndrome MINAS: report of six Argentinian families and a systematic review of the literature." (Fam Cancer, 2026). Abstract: Germline BRCA-Lynch syndrome MINAS: report of six Argentinian families and a systematic review of the literature.. The co-occurrence of germline pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants (PVs) in BRCA1/BRCA2 and mismatch repair genes (Lynch Syndrome) (BRCA-LS) is an infrequent overlap of the two most frequent hereditary cancer syndromes. Recent reviews have examined whether the cancer risk profile in BRCA-LS carriers is independent for both syndromes or if both germline variants act as mutual modifying factors, including a synergistic effect. This study on BRCA-LS Multi-locus Inherited Neoplasia Allele Syndrome (MINAS) aims to report six affected families, perform a systematic review (SR) of the literature to identify previously reported patients, and analyze the phenotype of this genetic condition. data.summary: The BRCA2 gene encodes the Breast cancer type 2 susceptibility protein and is involved in drug interactions, particularly with PARP inhibitors and platinum compounds. Limited clinical significance evidence is available, but it is associated with hereditary cancer syndromes and survival outcomes in breast cancer patients.
limitations: Limited direct clinical significance evidence for this specific variant.
Most evidence is from drug interactions and survival outcomes in broader contexts.

data.title: Grounded Interpretation
data.content:
The BRCA2 gene encodes the Breast cancer type 2 susceptibility protein and is involved in drug interactions, particularly with PARP inhibitors and platinum compounds. Limited clinical significance evidence is available, but it is associated with hereditary cancer syndromes and survival outcomes in breast cancer patients.

**Limitations:**
- Limited direct clinical significance evidence for this specific variant.
- Most evidence is from drug interactions and survival outcomes in broader contexts.
